He is wearing a fitted solid black short-sleeve t-shirt and clean white trousers, with realistic fabric texture, natural folds, and subtle highlights.

His head is gently tilted downward, eyes focused on the open book in his hands. Both hands hold the book naturally near his lap, with realistic fingers and grip.
